content: This challenge presents a clear opportunity for companies that invest in training and technology. Veralogix could establish its own in-house training academy to develop a pipeline of skilled personnel, creating a loyal and highly competent workforce. This can be a major selling point to clients who are also struggling with skills shortages. By strategically navigating these emerging challenges and capitalizing on the associated opportunities, Veralogix can not only ensure its resilience but also position itself as a forward-thinking leader in the evolution of the drilling and blasting industry.
